parent_objective: design source-history corpus expansion after fixed-corpus pass-surface swapping
blocked_by: M1313 pivots from objective tuning to source-history corpus expansion
supersedes: additional scalar objective tuning on the M1280/M1277 source-history corpus

public_gates: M1314 must not use private holdout
M1314 must preserve actor input contract
M1314 must define source-history expansion axes
M1314 must define corpus acceptance criteria
M1314 must define fold and holdout discipline for expanded corpus
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune the same 76 groups again without corpus expansion
do not include privileged labels in actor observations

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: starts a new source-history corpus expansion branch after M1313 pass-surface swapping audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: corpus design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design only repeats current 76 groups
stop if design omits pair-disjoint fold criteria
stop if design adds privileged actor inputs
stop if design routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if expansion design is admissible, implement a no-policy corpus plan builder
if current simulator cannot represent needed faults, route to simulator/source generator design
if branch scope is too large, split source generation from policy materialization
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: new branch opened by M1313 audit

admission_evidence: M1313 identifies scenario_sampling_failure as primary failure
M1312 aggregate gains still swap pass surfaces
current M1280 source-history substrate has only 38 pairs and 76 groups
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if plan builder is admitted

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1314 designs source-history corpus expansion and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design richer same-current wrong-history source pairs for later policy-side diagnostics
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If expansion cannot preserve human-view inputs or pair-disjoint folds, stop before materialization.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A larger and more source-diverse response-history corpus is needed before further source-history objective tuning can produce repeat-robust evidence.
success_criteria: design lists source fault families and scenario axes
design defines pair-disjoint fold and corpus size targets
design pre-registers a no-policy plan builder if implementation is admitted
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design repeats only current corpus axes
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1314 passes if it defines an expanded source-history corpus plan without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, privileged actor inputs, or actor-input expansion.
